description: This file defines an enum 'GatewayAutostartPolicy' with static methods to determine whether to start a gateway and ensure launch agent based on the application state and connection mode.

methods.name: shouldStartGateway
methods.description: Determines if the gateway should start based on connection mode and paused state.

methods.name: shouldEnsureLaunchAgent
methods.description: Determines if the launch agent should be ensured, delegating the decision to shouldStartGateway.
